limitations: Local warm baseline did not reproduce the reported five-second join delay; these are controlled loopback observations, not production/WAN performance claims.
Installed baseline Electron 45.1.0 and candidate 45.3.0 differ; combined-build differences cannot be attributed solely to this code patch.
Candidate fresh-process joins were slower: median 1927 ms / p95 2222 ms versus baseline 1637 / 1649 ms. The cause was not isolated; each cold cohort has only five samples.
Synthetic licensed active speech input, fake microphone and hidden windows do not validate physical device or speaker latency.
Measured PCM is decoded remote track data before app/OS output; cue PCM is downstream of actual product gain, before OS output.
Transport latency cohort disables noiseReduction identically for both synthetic accounts; one separate default-noise functional call does not characterize all microphones or speech.
Loopback fixture filters non-loopback STUN/TURN and cannot evaluate TURN, NAT, restricted networks or packet loss.
Old synchronous AudioParam gain.value cue counts were invalidated; only full rendered-PCM sound-control reports are used here.
Warm main series 19 and fresh-process cold series 5 are small samples; nearest-rank p95 in five cold samples equals their maximum.
